title: Customer onboarding and users (happy path)
env: Environment: dtp.ltsgroup.tech (web test) · Screenshots taken 05 Nov 2026 · Prepared by QA
intro: This flow takes a new customer from account creation by SGS to a Customer User who can see a scope. Test data: customer "[QA] D05 Smoke Onboarding 6p6k", scope "[QA] D05 Smoke Scope 6p6k".

SGS Portal = the portal at /ops used by SGS Admins and SGS consultants. Screenshots taken before 06 Nov 2026 show its old header name "Operations Console"; the web now shows "SGS Portal". It is the same portal.
Red boxes and labels were added for this document. Dates on screen are in Taiwan time (UTC+8); the bar above each screenshot shows Vietnam time (GMT+7).

steps.what: Create the customer account and invite its first Customer Admin.
steps.result: Customer account created; the Customer Admin is Invited.
body: Step 1 of the dialog holds the company and contact details. Step 2 holds the first Customer Admin. SGS sends only this first invitation; the Customer Admin invites the rest of the team.
shots: Step 1: company name (English and Traditional Chinese), contact and SGS affiliate.
Step 2: name and email of the first Customer Admin, then Create and send invitation.
Customer detail > Users: the Customer Admin is Invited.

steps.what: Open the invitation email and activate the account.
steps.result: Account is ready; role Customer Admin.
body: The link works once and expires after 7 days. On the test environment the email is read from Mailpit (the test mailbox).
shots: Invitation email in the test mailbox, with the Activate your account button.
Activate your account: full name, password that meets the rules, terms accepted.
Your account is ready: organisation and role.

steps.what: Sign in to the Customer Portal.
steps.result: Home page of the new customer, with the first steps to follow.
body: Home shows the setup steps: create a scope, then create a workspace.
shots: Home: Welcome, QA Smoke Admin, with the setup steps.

body: Required: type, name, company name, address, employee count and scope of certification.
shots: Create scope dialog with the required fields filled.

steps.result: User is Invited, with 0 of 1 scopes.
body: The dialog has two steps: details and role, then a check of the email address.
shots: Step 1: name, email and role User.
Step 2: confirm the address, then Send invitation.
Users list: the new user is Invited.

steps.what: Give the user access to the scope.
steps.result: The user is listed under People with access.
body: Customer Admins and Viewers see every scope. A Customer User sees only the scopes they are added to. An invited user can be added before they activate.
shots: Scope detail: People with access > Add users.
Add users to this scope: pick the user, then Add users.
The user now has access to the scope.

steps.what: Activate the account, sign in and open Scopes.
steps.result: The Customer User sees only the scope they were given.
shots: Invitation email for the Customer User.
Activate your account as Customer User.
Your account is ready: role Customer User.
Scopes list of the Customer User: only the scope they were added to.

limitations: On the SGS environment, sign-in and activation go through Microsoft Entra: the user sets the password on the Entra page, and Forgot password is handled by Entra, not by DTP.
The web test environment uses mock sign-in in place of Entra: every account signs in with one shared test password, not the password set at activation.
Sending email on the SGS environment depends on the SGS SMTP set-up. On the test environment all email goes to Mailpit (the test mailbox), never to real inboxes.
blocked: Activation from the invitation, setting the password, Forgot password.
Done on the Microsoft Entra page on the SGS environment; the test environment uses a mock sign-in with one shared password.
Invited Customer Admin and Customer User can activate, set a password, reset it, and sign in.
Sign-in on the SGS environment with Microsoft Entra.
The test environment uses a mock sign-in; Entra is set up only on the SGS DEV/UAT environment.
Each role can sign in to its portal through Entra.
On the test environment invitations go to Mailpit; real delivery depends on the SGS SMTP set-up.
Invitations arrive and the activation link works.
